## Introduction to `dplyr`

The `{dplyr}` package is part of the `{tidyverse}` package. It is best understood as a grammar of data manipulation, with `dplyr` functions acting as verbs that perform actions on datasets. 

Below are the most important `dplyr` verbs (functions) that we will cover in this course. Additional `dplyr` helper verbs will be introduced as needed.

| Data Frame Verb | Description                                |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------------|
| ``/`` | Select columns from a data frame           |
| ``      | Add new columns or modify existing columns |
| ``      | Keep rows that satisfy a condition         |
| ``  | Drop rows that satisfy a condition         |
| ``   | Calculate summary statistics for columns   |
| ``     | Reorder rows based on one or more columns  |
| ``| Convert data frame from wider to long format |
| `` | Convert data frame from long to wide format |
| ``   | Combine two data frames by matching values in a common column |
